title: Intimate Italian Pasta Class in Edmonton (Includes 4-Course Meal)
blurb:
Step into a welcoming Edmonton kitchen and discover the elegance of Italian cuisine in this immersive cooking class hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, the class highlights traditional techniques and fresh ingredients while you prepare a complete four-course menu.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Italian salad with crisp vegetables, olives and Parmesan
- Appetizer: Arancini with a crispy shell and mozzarella center
- Main course: Choice of homemade spaghetti with shrimp scampi or linguini with pomodoro chicken
- Dessert: Ricotta cake topped with blueberry compote

With expert instruction from your local pasta chef, you’ll gain the skills to craft authentic Italian dishes at home. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to complement the meal, making this a flavorful and interactive culinary evening.
